# Dependencies without generated-code identity

These are bindings for `fleet.common` from `../rev_a/configuration.brd`. They were generated by the schema compiler at `351a89e`, the last compiler before generated-code identity (#111 G1). They carry the A4.2 configuration identity (`<NS>_QUARRY_SCHEMA_ID_*` macros, `quarry_cfg_<schema_id>`) but no generated-code identity.

#117 renamed those macros. A current dependent therefore reports that this header predates generated configuration identity, which is the check that runs first. The generated-code identity diagnostic is covered separately, by deleting the current compiler's `_CODE_ID_FORMAT` macro from an otherwise current header.

The suffix keeps formatting hooks from rewriting genuine generator output. Don't regenerate these files with a newer compiler.
